target_applications: mobile manipulation research, imitation-learning data collection, household task demos

dof_total.source: 2x6 arm DoF + 2 base drive DoF; https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02117

reach_mm.source: ViperX 300 spec; workspace 650-2000mm height, 1000mm beyond base per paper

torso_lift.value: fixed frame (no lift); arms mounted to cover 0.65-2.0m heights

actuators.value: Dynamixel smart servos (arms); hub-motor diff drive (base)

end_effector.value: parallel-jaw grippers with custom low-cost fingers

sensors_head.value: 1x Logitech C922x RGB webcam (front/top view), 640x480 @ 50Hz; no depth/lidar

sensors_wrist_hand.value: 2x Logitech C922x wrist RGB cameras; no F/T or tactile

compute.value: consumer laptop: Intel i7-12800H, RTX 3070 Ti 8GB

software_stack.value: ROS; open-source MIT (MarkFzp/mobile-aloha, act-plus-plus); ACT, Diffusion Policy, VINN imitation learning; whole-body teleop

price.value: ~USD 32,000 self-build BOM; Trossen Mobile AI kit ~USD 23-34k

availability.value: open-source plans worldwide; commercial kits via Trossen Robotics / AgileX

deployment_evidence.value: research only; replicated by many labs; DeepMind ALOHA 2 / Unleashed follow-ups; lineage to Sunday Robotics Memo

notes: Research platform, not a product. Success rates 80-95% on household tasks with 20-50 demos + co-training. Stanford PR1 (2006-08, Salisbury lab) is the historic predecessor that led to Willow Garage PR2.
